A '''species''' of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] was part of a symbiotic relationship with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[M'shinn]] species. The moss like plant grew on the species skin and covered their entire bodies apart from the soles of their [[Limb/Legends|feet]] and the palms of their hands. The plants were [[Color/Legends|green]] in color, with the shade depending on the environment and light source available to them.<ref name="GG12" />
